prompts.title: Colorful Scribble Art Family Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed hand-drawn scribble-art portrait using the uploaded family photo only as the reference for each person’s facial identity, age, gender, skin tone, hairstyle, and family members. Include exactly the same 3 or 4 people—do not add, remove, replace, or merge anyone. Do not copy the original pose, composition, background, or exact clothing.
Create a fresh, professionally arranged family pose. Place the entire family prominently in the center of a vertical composition, close together with warm, natural interaction. Position the parents behind or beside the children, gently leaning inward. For one child, place them centrally between or slightly in front of the parents; an infant or toddler may be held naturally. For two children of any age or gender, arrange both clearly in the center foreground or between the parents with balanced spacing and every face fully visible. Give everyone warm, natural expressions directed toward the viewer.
Restyle the family in coordinated, elegant outfits suitable for their age, gender, and cultural appearance. If the reference clothing is very simple, enhance it with richer colors, tasteful patterns, refined fabric details, subtle embroidery, layering, or appropriate accessories. The outfits should look stylish and complementary without becoming overly formal. Do not reproduce the exact original clothes.
Render the portrait using thousands of overlapping, free-flowing thin pen strokes and colorful ink scribbles in black, blue, orange, pink, purple, and red. Preserve recognizable facial features, realistic anatomy, expressive eyes, intricate crosshatching, delicate shading, and accurate proportions.
Use clean white textured paper as the background. Keep the family sharply detailed and fully defined at the center, while the outer edges of their clothing and surrounding linework gradually dissolve into loose, colorful scribbles and softly fade into the white background on both sides. Maintain balanced negative space around the centered family.
Eye-level medium family portrait, gallery-quality traditional pen-and-ink illustration, vibrant artistic energy, ultra-sharp detail, vertical composition. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: 3D Couple Miniature
prompts.prompt:
Create a cute premium 3D animated collectible figurine scene of the uploaded couple, using their photo only as the identity reference. Turn them into an adorable husband and wife standing close together on a small round display base. Preserve their recognizable age, facial features, hairstyle, glasses if present, skin tone, and warm loving expressions, but render them in a soft Pixar-style / clay-toy figurine look.

The man stands on the left with a gentle smile, one arm lovingly around the woman’s shoulder, while the woman stands on the right, smiling warmly up at him. Their pose should feel affectionate, calm, and lifelong-romantic.
Dress both subjects in outfits inspired by their own cultural background, keeping the clothing elegant, traditional or semi-traditional, age-appropriate, modest, and visually harmonious. The outfits should feel authentic to the couple’s culture rather than generic Western clothing. For example, use culturally relevant garments, layering, patterns, jewelry, and overall styling that suit the couple naturally, while still keeping the look soft, premium, and simplified for a collectible figurine design. Avoid exaggerated costumes; keep the styling tasteful, warm, and realistic to their background.

Place a vintage black street lamp beside them with a warm glowing lantern. Attach wooden arrow signboards to the lamp post with clean readable engraved text: “MARRIED SINCE”, “HUSBAND NAME”, and “WIFE NAME”. On the front of the round base, add elegant golden text: “ENDLESS ♥ LOVE”.

Set the figurine on a wooden tabletop inside a cozy softly blurred living room, with warm golden lighting, shallow depth of field, premium miniature-diorama feel, soft shadows, smooth toy-like textures, detailed fabric, and realistic lamp glow. Keep the composition centered, heartwarming, clean, and gift-like. Square aspect ratio 1:1.

prompts.title: Modern Halo
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for the subject’s face and identity reference. Preserve the person’s recognizable facial structure, hairstyle, and facial hair if present.

Create a premium stylized cinematic AI portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. The image should look like high-end hyper-detailed digital artwork with a refined semi-realistic 3D-render finish, not a natural camera photograph and not a cartoon.

Show the subject from lower-chest upward, slightly left of center, in a strong three-quarter profile facing camera-right. Use a subtle low camera angle, with the portrait viewed slightly from below, so the subject appears more powerful and dominant in frame. Keep the chin slightly raised, lips closed, and expression calm, serious, powerful, and self-assured. Add black rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses and glossy reflections.

Dress the subject in a plain oversized black hoodie with thick soft fabric, visible drawstrings, deep folds, and rich shadow detail.

Place a large perfectly circular glowing amber-gold celestial disc directly behind the head and shoulders. The disc must have a dark luxurious golden-orange surface with soft smoky texture, brushed-metal-like patterns, subtle celestial grain, darker bronze edges, and a warm inner glow. Do not make it a realistic pale full moon, bright white moon, or highly visible crater moon.

Use a nearly black background with faint warm brown haze around the disc. Add a controlled bright golden edge light around the hair, ears, shoulders, hood, and outer hoodie silhouette. Keep the face partly shadowed with warm orange highlights along the cheek, jawline, nose edge, and beard.

Make the subject sharp and visually dominant, with dramatic contrast, sculpted facial shading, rich black clothing, detailed textured hair, stylized beard detail if present, deep shadows, glowing amber rim light, dark luxury fantasy-poster mood, premium AI artwork, cinematic digital portrait, ultra-detailed, 8K.

prompts.title: Contours of Love
prompts.prompt:
Hyper-realistic 3D layered papercut and paper quilling sculpture, showcasing masterful papercraft artistry with a blend of matte and metallic paper textures.
Composition:
Symmetrical dual bust portraits centered in the frame. The male subject on the left and the female subject on the right face each other in close proximity. Their flowing ribbon-like forms merge at the base, elegantly converging into a refined heart shape that forms the lower structure of the sculpture. This heart-shaped base is seamlessly integrated into the design and gently rests on a minimal, smooth wooden stand (light natural wood tone, clean edges, gallery-style plinth).
Subjects & Styling:
Male (Left): Constructed from layered paper forms. Hair & beard (if present in the reference image) is styled in smooth, sculpted waves using thick silver metallic paper strips. His collar/outfit is formed from broad, flowing silver ribbons.
Female (Right): Constructed from delicate layered paper. Hair is an intricate quilled updo made from fine rose-gold metallic paper strips. Her drapery mirrors this style with soft, flowing ribbon forms.
Facial Detail:
Both faces feature subtle, contour-following layered paper cuts that define facial structure (cheeks, jawline, temples), enhancing depth and emphasizing the handcrafted papercut aesthetic.
Pose & Expression:
Clean side-profile views, perfectly aligned face-to-face. Their faces are inches apart, slightly leaning inward. Both subjects are looking directly into each other’s eyes, conveying a soft romantic expression with a sense of intimacy and emotional connection, without physical contact.
Lighting:
Soft, diffused studio lighting to enhance depth and cast subtle, realistic shadows between paper layers.
A warm, glowing backlight is placed precisely in the background between their faces, creating a soft halo and a focal point in the negative space.
Background:
Minimal, seamless matte off-white background for a clean, gallery-style presentation.
Camera & Technical:
Straight-on, eye-level shot, perfectly perpendicular to maintain the flat graphic profile while emphasizing 3D depth.
85mm lens, f/5.6, ISO 100, ultra-sharp focus, 8K resolution, high-end editorial product photography style, crisp detail on paper edges and layered contours.
Style Keywords:
papercraft sculpture, paper quilling art, layered paper design, metallic textures, minimalism, romantic symmetry, ultra-detailed, studio lighting, soft shadows
Aspect ratio 4:5.
No text, no logo, no distortion, no outfit from reference image.

prompts.title: The Creative Lead
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-high-detail 3D animated character portrait in a premium Disney/Pixar-inspired style, designed to feel highly appealing, expressive, and avatar-friendly.

Composition:
Medium portrait (waist-up), centered, slightly body turned one side, eye-level camera angle. Subject fills ~65–75% of the frame.

Subject:
Stylized male character with slightly chibi-influenced proportions — subtly larger head (~10–15% larger than realistic proportion) and a slightly compact, youthful body while still maintaining an adult identity. Clean facial structure, smooth but detailed skin, highly expressive large eyes (not cartoonishly oversized).

Hair & Accessories:
Neatly styled, soft-volume hair with visible strand detail. Thick matte grey rim glasses, well-fitted and premium-looking.

Outfit:
Matte black long-sleeve button-down shirt with collar and two chest pockets. Sleeves rolled to mid-forearms.
Fabric must feel premium and realistic — visible micro-texture, stitching, natural folds, soft cloth behavior, subtle specular highlights (no plastic look).

Pose (IMPORTANT):
Arms confidently crossed. Body slightly angled (~15° right) to avoid flatness. Head turned toward camera with strong, natural posture.

Expression:
Highly joyful, warm, and engaging smile — friendly and likable (avatar appeal focus), not exaggerated to the point of distortion. Eyes lively with strong emotional presence.

Background:
Pure white seamless studio background (#FFFFFF), completely clean and minimal.

Behind the subject, add a large round shape in a rich yellow color gradient. The shape must be centered behind the subject’s head and upper torso, occupying ~50–70% of the background width.
Smooth edges, flat matte finish, no texture
Creating a strong contrast with the black outfit and helping the subject stand out visually.

No shadows cast on the white background, only a faint soft separation shadow between subject and shape if needed.
Lighting:
Soft high-key studio lighting. Even facial illumination with gentle shadow depth.
Subtle rim light on the left side of the hair and the shoulder for separation. Bright, crisp eye catchlights.

Rendering & Quality:
8K ultra-detailed render, Unreal Engine 5/Octane quality.
PBR materials, subsurface scattering for natural skin glow, high-resolution textures, sharp focus, clean premium color grading.
Stylized realism — no AI artifacts, no over-smoothing, no plastic skin.

Aspect Ratio: 4:5

prompts.title: The Modern Avatar
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity, 3D-rendered character portrait in the style of modern feature-film animation (such as Pixar or DreamWorks). Use the uploaded image only for facial reference to preserve identity while maintaining a polished, cinematic animated aesthetic.

Instruction (CRITICAL): Strictly IGNORE the pose details from the reference image.

Composition & Framing
The subject is positioned lower-right, as if peeking into view, with the chest up framing.
Ooccupies approximately 60–70% of the area in the frame, ensuring strong visual presence.
A head tilt for a friendly, approachable demeanour.
Pose should be natural.
Vertical aspect ratio (4:5).
Shallow depth of field with the subject in sharp focus and the background perfectly smooth.

Background
A seamless, ultra-smooth gradient with no texture or noise.

Diagonal color transition:
Deep magenta/pink in the upper left,
Vibrant orange in the center,
Bright golden-yellow in the lower right.
Soft, clean, and studio-like with a subtle bokeh-style finish.

Appearance & Expression
Stylized yet believable proportions typical of high-end animated films.
Warm, friendly, and charismatic expression with a subtle, confident smile.
Large, expressive eyes with natural catchlights.
Natural skin shading with realistic subsurface scattering for a lifelike appearance.
Expression should be natural.

Attire & Accessories
Modern, casual outfit (e.g, t-shirt, hoodie) with a clean, minimal design.
Contemporary eyewear with realistic reflections and refraction.
Physically accurate fabric textures with visible stitching and natural folds.

Lighting
Key Light: Soft, diffused light from the upper right, producing gentle highlights on the face.
Fill Light: Subtle illumination from the left to maintain balanced shadows and a friendly mood.
Global Illumination: Soft bounce lighting for realism.
Subsurface Scattering: Visible in the skin, especially around the ears and nose.
Soft reflections on accessories such as glasses.

Technical Specifications
High-end 3D CGI rendered using Physically Based Rendering (PBR).
Ultra-detailed textures with high-resolution normal and bump maps.
Clean topology and cinematic color grading.
Smooth anti-aliasing and studio-quality rendering.
8K resolution, ultra-sharp details.
Vibrant yet balanced color harmony.

Identity Constraint
Use the uploaded image strictly only for facial and identity reference.
Preserve facial structure, proportions, and likeness with high accuracy.
Do not alter ethnicity or introduce distortions.

Negative Prompt
Blurry, low resolution, noisy background, harsh shadows, flat lighting, distorted face, unnatural pose, exaggerated caricature, over-smoothing, plastic skin, dull colors, artifacts, incorrect anatomy, asymmetry, watermark, text, logo, cluttered background, grain, oversharpening.
